meaning: The name Ibrahim, meaning “father of many nations,” belongs to one of the most revered prophets in Islam. Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) is mentioned 69 times across 25 chapters of the Quran, and the 14th Surah bears his name — a symbol of unwavering faith, devotion, and leadership.
dua_translation: O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness and well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
